items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: The transcript only identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer. The interviewee (Ed Soph) does not mention any personal or professional relationship with Monk Rowe.

ctx.x: Ed was interviewed via Zoom on February 9, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and a real pleasure to have Ed Soph with me today, drummer and jazz educator, and one of the early students of jazz education. Am I correct? North Texas State way back?
Right. Actually when I was there, I was there from 1963 through ’68 and there was no jazz degree yet.
